figure_goal: Show that each TRACER evidence-graph gate blocks a distinct pre-specified unsafe HIGH escalation in the frozen factorial safety suite.
paper_claim: The added transport, source-independence, all-cohort-FDR, and provenance modules provide distinct deterministic safeguards beyond a naive counting baseline.

panels.name: A
panels.content: Unsafe HIGH counts among the 31 ineligible complete drafts for Full TRACER, three single-gate ablations, and naive counting.

panels.name: B
panels.content: Unsafe HIGH counts among 32 provenance-omission drafts for Full TRACER and the no-provenance ablation.

panels.name: C
panels.content: HIGH versus BLOCK decisions for the eligible control and three predeclared single-failure critical cells.

data.finite_enumeration: 32 complete factorial drafts plus 32 provenance-omission drafts

style_constraints: no p values or confidence intervals
verification_checklist: All plotted values must agree with the frozen summary JSON.
All three panels must state their denominator or decision semantics.
The figure must distinguish complete-draft and provenance-omission denominators.
No biological, clinical, or model-performance conclusion may appear in the figure.
